def rects_of(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            a=g[i][j]
            h=max(kk for kk in range(1,H-i+1) if all(g[y][j]==a for y in range(i,i+kk)))
            w=max(kk for kk in range(1,W-j+1) if all(g[i][x]==a for x in range(j,j+kk)))
            full=all(g[y][x]==a for y in range(i,i+h) for x in range(j,j+w))
            res.append((full,h,w,a,i,j))
    return res

def f(g):
